item.title: Upton Bass Launches Chicago Double Bass Inspired by the Kay M-1
item.description: Upton Bass has unveiled the Chicago upright bass, a new model inspired by the legendary Kay M-1 and built using original Kay rib molds.

item.title: Keanu Reeves Returns to the Low End as Dogstar Announces "All In Now" and 2026 Tour
item.description: Keanu Reeves and Dogstar have announced their new album All In Now, arriving May 29, along with a global tour and a heavy new title track.

item.title: Watch Keanu Reeves Hold Down the Groove in Dogstar’s New “All In Now” Video
item.description: Dogstar have released the official video for “All In Now,” the title track of their upcoming album. Keanu Reeves holds down the bass as the trio launches a new tour era.

item.title: Paul McCartney’s Record-Setting Yamaha BB-1200 Leads Auction With Basses by Dusty Hill and John McVie
item.description: Christie’s upcoming Jim Irsay Collection auction includes legendary basses from Paul McCartney, Dusty Hill, and John McVie.

item.title: Don’t Throw Away Your Strings: FRET12 Launches the “String Thing” Upcycling Figure
item.description: FRET12 has introduced the String Thing, a DIY collectible figure designed to be wrapped with old guitar or bass strings, giving dead strings a creative second life.

item.title: Kade Turner Covers Tool’s “Schism,” One of Bass’s Most Iconic Lines
item.description: Watch Kade Turner power through Tool’s “Schism,” using a Warwick 4-string, GK Legacy stack, and Bass Whammy to capture the song’s unmistakable bass tone.

item.title: Bass News Roundup: Boss GX-1B, Carbonetti Bowery Bass, Joe Dart’s Vulfmon Groove & More
item.description: This week’s bass highlights include the Boss GX-1B pedal, the Carbonetti Bowery Bass, Joe Dart with Vulfmon, new gear, lessons, and more.

item.title: EarthQuaker Devices Unveils Towers Stereo Reverberant Filter for Massive Soundscapes
item.description: EarthQuaker Devices has unveiled the Towers Stereo Reverberant Filter, a new pedal designed to generate massive ambient soundscapes with manual, envelope, and LFO modes.

item.title: Gorillaz Make Their SNL Debut with a Two-Song Set: “Clint Eastwood” and “The Moon Cave,” Featuring Bassist Seye Adelekan
item.description: Gorillaz made their debut on Saturday Night Live this weekend, delivering a two song set that pulled together several corners of their musical universe. The band opened with “Clint Eastwood,” joined by the track’s original guest, Del the Funky Homosapien, before shifting into “The Moon Cave,” a newer cut from the album The Mountain. item.title: This Hybrid Chestnut 8-String Bass by May Custom Basses Is Stunning
item.description: The May Custom Basses DCSM8MS Origin is a striking multi-scale 8-string bass featuring hybrid stabilized chestnut, three Ulyate pickups, and neck-through construction.
